plugins.name: vpk-html
plugins.description: Render supplied material into offline, single-file HTML artifacts with the Algebrica editorial identity (Geist + Geist Mono, warm paper, grayscale figures). HTML-first, Node-only, with an optional derived PDF export and a landing/product-site track. Built for documents and engineering work: one-pagers, reports, decks, changelogs, portfolios, resumes, PR writeups, code reviews, status reports, incident reports, and more.
